leveraged_or_inverse_token.rule: pattern rule: base asset name ending in UP, DOWN, BULL, BEAR, or matching \d+[LS]$ (e.g. 3L/3S tokens)

stablecoin_base.rule: base asset is designed to track a fiat currency or basket (collateralized, algorithmic, or yield-bearing wrapper)

wrapped_same_asset.rule: wrappers of the quote asset itself

notes: Coverage audited at ingestion: every discovered symbol is classified included/excluded with its category and rule match recorded; unknown fiat-pegged assets discovered later require a NEW registry version (never a silent edit).
policy: Point-in-time exclusion registry (protocol §4 instrument scope; review verdict §6). Classifications are append-only: a new version may ADD entries or categories but historical classifications are never silently changed after results exist — any change is a new registry version recorded in the dataset manifest with old and new hashes. The exact registry version and every symbol's classification at ingestion are preserved in the dataset manifest.
